location_description:
Sebastopol ( sib-AST-ə-pohl, -⁠pool) is a city in Sonoma County, in California with a recorded population of 7,379, per the 2010 U.S. Census.
Sebastopol was once primarily a plum and apple-growing region. Today, wine grapes are the predominant agriculture crop, and nearly all lands once used for orchards are now vineyards.
